extraction_method: pdftotext -layout plus manual table structuring; MIN, TYP, and MAX semantics retained

aol.conditions: Held behavioral gain because the datasheet publishes no large-signal gain

vos.conditions: Magnitude of the published TYP offset; sign is arbitrary in a nominal model
vos.page_reference: p. 3 input offset voltage row, TYP column

vos_max.page_reference: p. 3 input offset voltage row, MIN/MAX columns

ibias.page_reference: p. 3 input bias current row, TYP column

ios.page_reference: p. 3 input offset current row, TYP column

hysteresis.conditions: No TYP value is published. Held at the midpoint of the 1 mV MIN and 5 mV MAX production window.
hysteresis.page_reference: p. 3 input hysteresis row, MIN/MAX columns

hysteresis_min.page_reference: p. 3 input hysteresis row, MIN column

hysteresis_max.page_reference: p. 3 input hysteresis row, MAX column

iq.page_reference: p. 3 quiescent current row, TYP column

minimum.page_reference: p. 3 supply voltage row, MIN column

maximum.page_reference: p. 3 supply voltage row, MAX column

output_high_min.page_reference: p. 3 high-level output voltage row, MIN column

output_low_max.page_reference: p. 3 low-level output voltage row, MAX column

short_circuit_current.page_reference: p. 3 short-circuit current row, TYP column

tphl.conditions: 100 mV overdrive, VCM = VDD/2, VDD = 5.5 V, RL = 10 kohm to VDD/2, CL = 25 pF
tphl.page_reference: p. 4 propagation delay row, TYP column

tplh.conditions: 100 mV overdrive, VCM = VDD/2, VDD = 5.5 V, RL = 10 kohm to VDD/2, CL = 25 pF
tplh.page_reference: p. 4 propagation delay row, TYP column

minimum.page_reference: p. 3 common-mode input range row, MIN column

maximum.page_reference: p. 3 common-mode input range row, MAX column
